title: Banff Tour — Hike in Sunshine Meadow & Johnston Canyon — Gondolas
includes: Banff Gondola Fee — Price fluctuates around (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a refreshing one-day Banff hiking tour to bask in the scenery of one of the world's most beautiful National Parks. Stroll through Johnston Canyon and take in the sights, wander Sunshine Meadows admiring the gorgeous flora and natural beauty of the valley. Finally, relax and feel your spirits soar in a gondola up to Sulphur Mountain to feel the alpine breeze and drink in the wonders of the peaceful Rockies.

A tour designed for hiking lovers, our guide will help you cover three of the Kananaskis Country's most beloved moderate trails, showcasing Canada's finest scenery. This adventure is best paired with our Lake View Day Tour to give you a a two-day unforgettable experience, immersing yourself in all that Banff and it's surrounding beauties has to offer.
